properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Solutions turned over 2026-09-02 for a cause recorded on 2026-08-16 and unrepaired since.

THE SETTLED PART: `loop_status` prints "N answered question(s) never reached the design — write the answer in, or acknowledge the gap" from `questions.iter().filter(|q| q.status == "answered").count()`. That counter knows the question is answered and its gap is open. It knows nothing about whether design nodes exist. The 2026-08-16 fact already names the honest narrow repair; three sessions across three projects have now paid full diagnosis for it.

OPTIONS, none preferred:

· **A — Shrink the message to what it knows.** "N question(s) are answered and their gap is still open." Drop both prescriptions, or replace them with a neutral prompt. Costs nothing, breaks nothing, available today, and it is what the original fact proposed. ⚠️ It makes the line honest and also less useful: a reader still cannot tell a deferral from a genuinely unwritten answer, which is the thing they actually want to know.

· **B — Infer the deferred case**, chama's suggestion: when the answered question's gap is BLOCKS-ed or GOVERNED_BY an open Decision, report it as DEFERRED rather than UNWRITTEN. Reads a ruling the design already made, which is the move `req:a-deliberate-state-is-not-a-defect` asks for throughout. ⚠️ It is a heuristic: an open Decision standing near a gap is not proof that the answer was written, and a wrong DEFERRED is more reassuring than a wrong UNWRITTEN, which makes its failure mode the worse-shaped one.

· **C — Make the fact recordable: a typed edge saying THIS RECORD ANSWERS THAT QUESTION.** The computation stops being an inference and becomes a lookup. ⭐ MEASURED TODAY: `describe_schema{from: Decision, to: Question}` returns ZERO exact and ZERO half-exact matches — nothing models the pair, so this needs new vocabulary rather than wiring. ⭐ AND IT CONVERGES WITH AN INDEPENDENT REPORT: api-boss proposed exactly this on 2026-08-15 for a DIFFERENT defect ("let a Decision CLOSE a Question with an edge, making the linkage first-class and surviving whichever id scheme wins" — `fact:defect-a-question-not-created-by-gap-to-prompt-can-never-be-answered`). Two projects, two symptoms, one missing edge. ⚠️ The counter is this project's own bar: `dec:edge-orthogonality` says a vocabulary distinction earns its keep only if a computation reads it — which this one would, so the bar is cleared, but it is still new vocabulary for a line of text.

· **D — Drop the line entirely** while it cannot be computed. ⚠️ Loses a real signal: an answer that genuinely never got written IS debt, and it would go unreported.

⭐ THE SHAPE WORTH NOTICING: A is a prose repair to a prose defect, and C makes the claim true by giving it something to read. `rule:fix-it-properly-while-it-is-still-cheap` points at C; the fact that A has been available and unbuilt for seventeen days points at how little the cheap repair is worth on its own.

NOT ESTABLISHED: whether an answer can land as something other than a Decision — a Requirement, a status move, a bare edge — often enough that a Decision→Question edge would cover only part of the ground. The 2026-08-16 fact says outright that "was this answer written into the design" has no general computation, which is an argument that C solves the tractable half and leaves the rest.
properties.name: SETTLED in two steps on Anthony's word, 2026-09-02 — option A shipped first (the line says only what it knows), then option C (the ANSWERS edge makes the fact recordable). Option B, inferring a deferral, stays unbuilt and is now unnecessary
properties.rationale:
Recorded rather than acted on because A and C are not the same size and the choice between them is the user's: A is a sentence and can ship immediately; C is vocabulary, has an independent second use already recorded, and would make the claim computable rather than merely modest.

The convergence with api-boss's 2026-08-15 proposal is the reason this is worth a node at all. One project asking for an edge is a feature request; two projects reaching it from unrelated symptoms is evidence the edge is missing.
